resources.title: Strategic vs Tactical Questions for Change
resources.description: A short guide with questions to help distinguish strategic issues from tactical ones in a change initiative.
resources.learning_objective: Help the practitioner distinguish strategic from tactical questions.
when_to_recommend: Practitioner is stuck in a task list and needs to lift perspective
Practitioner is preparing for a sponsor conversation
follow_up_questions: What changed in how you view the issue?
How does this show up in your current change?

resources.title: Stakeholder Mapping for Change
resources.description: A worksheet for identifying stakeholders, their interests, and their likely reactions to a change.
when_to_recommend: Practitioner needs to understand who is affected
Practitioner is planning communication or engagement
follow_up_questions: What does that perspective mean for your plan?

resources.title: Second-Order Effects in Organizations
resources.description: A short audio piece introducing second-order and downstream effects in organizational change.
resources.learning_objective: Help the practitioner look beyond immediate change effects.
when_to_recommend: Practitioner is surprised by unintended consequences
Practitioner is about to make a major change decision
follow_up_questions: What second-order effect could you see in your change?
How would you prepare for it?

resources.title: Dependency Map Template
resources.description: A simple template for mapping the people, processes, and systems a change depends on.
resources.learning_objective: Help the practitioner identify and communicate dependencies.
follow_up_questions: What dependency is most at risk?
What would you do if it slips?

resources.title: Framing Change Recommendations for Sponsors
resources.description: A guide for structuring change recommendations so they are clear, concise, and useful for sponsors.
resources.learning_objective: Help the practitioner frame recommendations for executive audiences.
when_to_recommend: Practitioner is preparing a sponsor recommendation
Practitioner is moving from analysis to advice
follow_up_questions: What is the core decision you are asking the sponsor to make?
What would change if they said yes?
